svg.title: The kinds of JOIN, on the same data
svg.desc: At the top, the customer table with Ana, Bruno and Carla and the orders table with orders 101 and 102 for Ana, 103 for Bruno and 104 for a non-existent customer 4. Below, five panels with Venn diagrams and results: INNER JOIN returns Ana 101, Ana 102 and Bruno 103; LEFT JOIN adds Carla with NULL; RIGHT JOIN adds order 104 with a NULL name; FULL JOIN brings both; and CROSS JOIN produces 3 times 4, 12 combinations.
svg.text: The kinds of JOIN, on the same data
Two small tables and what each join returns
ON o.customer_id = c.id in all of them except CROSS JOIN. Where there is no match, the database fills in NULL.
